plugin.name: AVPlayer Preview
plugin.description: macOS (Apple Silicon only) local MP4/MOV preview using AVPlayer. No transcoding. Prototype: decoded-frame display capped at 1280px / 30fps.
plugin.change-notes:
• Initial release: preview local MP4 / M4V / MOV files in an editor tab with macOS AVPlayer, without transcoding.
  • Apple Silicon (arm64) only. Intel Macs show an error instead of playing.
  • Display frames are scaled to at most 1280 px on the long side at about 30 fps. HDR10 / HLG video is tone-mapped to SDR.
  • Video info panel: container, codec, resolution, rotation, frame rate, bit depth, color, HDR type and audio format.
